meme_name: Ab Underground Hone Ka Samay Aa Gaya Hai
text: Ab Underground Hone Ka Samay Aa Gaya Hai is a reaction image and exploitable meme that stems from the 2012 Indian Bollywood crime movie Gangs of Wasseypur . The meme depicts the protagonist Sardar Khan (played by Manoj Bajpayee) with a cloth over his head with text that translates to, "It is now time to go underground." While there is no instance of the character delivering the line in the actual movie, the meme has been in circulation since the release of the film in 2012.

meme_name: Ab Underground Hone Ka Samay Aa Gaya Hai
text: On June 22nd, 2012, the Indian crime movie Gangs Of Wasseypur was released. The film does not contain a scene where protagonist Sardar Khan (played by Manoj Bajpayee) says "Ab underground hone ka samay aa gaya hai," which translates to, "the time has come to go underground." However, a clip [1] of the actor with the image in question can be accessed below. The earliest known use of the image is a July 3rd, 2015 post by Twitter [2] user @EngineeRoholic, gathering over 800 likes and 1,400 retweets in eight years (seen below).

text: The image continued to be sporadically used between 2015 and 2018. On September 22, 2019, Instagram [7] page @deadlylaw posted a version of the meme, gathering nearly 1000 likes in three years (seen below, right). On December 7th, 2019, Instagram [8] page @upscmeme posted a version of the meme that gathered over 5,000 likes in three years (seen below, left). On January 3rd, 2020, Instagram [9] page @webseriesmania posted a deleted tweet that used the meme, gathering over 1,000 likes in three years (seen below, right).
